moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio scroll-depth-zoom, written here): Surface 224x134 r10 at centre: scale 0.78 → 1 around a fixed centre and brightness 0.7 → 1 (a 30 % dark overlay fades out) over 1.2 s (0.3-1.5 s) power2.inOut; a dashed final-size outline fades out as it lands. Demo reverses 2.6-3.2 s. Params: scale (0.78 → 1) · brightness (0.7 → 1) · duration (1.2 s) · ease (power2.inOut).
